analysis.title: Retail has hit the sell button - the largest amount of retail net selling since late July
key_insights: Vanda sees heavy retail selling in US single stocks in the first 30 minutes of the 5 Nov 2026 cash session, the largest 30-minute selling episode since October by a significant margin.
Retail selling is concentrated in tech single names and is on track to be the largest amount of retail selling since the late July capitulation.
After the late July low, retail selling continued for a number of days and persisted when the market began to recover. Vanda's Jai Malhi says to look for institutional buying to help any recovery.
Names that the Situational Awareness fund held in June are among the heavily sold by retail today. The fund's offload was one of the catalysts around the 29 Jul low.
The sell-off brings CTA selling into play. Vanda likely avoided big CTA selling on election night, but with 27,600 broken, CTAs will likely turn outright short.

sector_views.rationale: Retail investors are heavy net sellers of single names, particularly in tech, on 5 Nov 2026.

risk_factors: Retail selling could persist for several days and continue into a market recovery, as it did after the late July low.
A break below 26,800 would likely deepen CTA selling to LibDay lows.
Further liquidation of names previously held by the Situational Awareness fund.
vol_and_positioning: Retail net selling in US single stocks is the largest 30-minute episode since October and on track to be the largest since late July.

A clean break below 26,800 would likely take CTA exposure down to the LibDay lows.
Vanda likely avoided big CTA selling on election night.
